ShortDescription.Value: Adds normal construction menus, reliable road renaming, and optional native Tree Controller, Recolor, and Road Builder support to the Map Editor.

Publish.LongDescription:
Map Editor Bridge brings the base game's familiar construction toolbar and asset menus into the Map Editor.
Select normal roads, networks, buildings, services, landscaping, and other placeable assets using the same menu structure used in gameplay. The bridge hands each selection back to the editor's native placement context, preserving editor previews, snapping, curve modes, elevation controls, and camera input.
Features: - Normal construction toolbar and searchable asset grids in the Map Editor - Native road and object placement tools - Native, save-safe renaming for a selected road, with automatic-name restore - Protection against malformed null asset-pack badge references in the stock editor prefab picker - A dedicated Build menus button to hide or restore the construction UI - A secondary Mod list drawer naming every supported optional integration - Verified optional Road Builder [BETA] integration (PDX 87190) through Road Builder's native editor tool - Verified optional Recolor integration (PDX 84638) through Recolor's native editor Color Painter - Verified optional Tree Controller integration (PDX 75993) through the normal Landscaping and Vegetation menus - A compact draggable Move It launcher beside the lower-left editor tools - Population, economy, traffic, and other gameplay simulation systems remain off
Supported optional integrations: - Image Overlay (PDX 74539) - Anarchy (PDX 74604) - Better Bulldozer (PDX 75250) - 529 Tiles (PDX 74328) - Move It (PDX 74324) - Network Tools [Early Access] (PDX 133736) - Tree Controller (PDX 75993) - Recolor (PDX 84638) - Road Builder [BETA] (PDX 87190) - Unified Icon Library (PDX 74417, recognized dependency)
The construction-menu bridge has no required mod dependencies. The Mod list names the supported integrations and leaves each mod's own code in control. Road Builder and its own dependencies are required only for Road Builder features; they are not required to use Map Editor Bridge.
Source code: https://github.com/ximxesabortion/cities2/tree/main/map-editor-bridge
Support and discussion: https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/threads/beta-map-editor-bridge-support-feedback-and-bug-reports.1936364/
Back up important maps before using any editor tool. This is an unofficial community mod and is not affiliated with Paradox Interactive or the game developers.
Publish.ChangeLog:
Icon and name resilience.
- Uses the game's single stock prefab UI binding service instead of registering a competing duplicate - Prevents editor support bindings from interfering with normal gameplay icon and prefab-detail requests - Adds an initials fallback when a construction icon URL is absent or fails to load - Shows each construction button's name in a compact hover and keyboard-focus label
